scripts.electron: npm run build && npm --prefix electron start
scripts.electron-dev: npm run build && BLOCKBUILDER_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 npm --prefix electron run dev
scripts.electron-dev:devtools: npm run dev &  npm --prefix electron run dev:devtools
scripts.electron-dist: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run dist
scripts.electron-dist:mac: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run dist -- --mac
scripts.electron-dist:win: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run dist -- --win
scripts.electron-dist:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run dist -- --linux
